description: This file defines the ReportWritePlatformService interface, which provides methods for creating, updating, and deleting reports within the Fineract infrastructure data queries module.

classes.name: ReportWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface for report management operations such as create, update, and delete.

methods.name: createReport
methods.description: Creates a new report based on the provided JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateReport
methods.description: Updates an existing report identified by reportId with new data from JsonCommand.

methods.name: deleteReport
methods.description: Deletes the report identified by reportId.
